create_MeteorScorer: create a MeteorScorer instance to evaluate translation quality using NLTK METEOR scoring

score_MeteorScorer: compute the mean METEOR score across all reference and prediction pairs
result_string_MeteorScorer: get a formatted METEOR score string with four decimal places
review_MeteorScorerConfig: review the MeteorScorerConfig dataclass used for fairseq scorer registration
